method: Authenticated account Settings, six V2 Ads in the native table and its configuration-only CSV, and individual Campaign URL options panels. Setting panels were cancelled without saving. Report filters and columns were adjusted for inspection; no live serving configuration changed.

auto_tagging.checkbox: Tag the URL that people click through from my ad

account_settings.limits: Call reporting being selected is not proof of a connected call, attribution, recording consent, provider support or conversion acceptance. The unchecked recording/forwarding choices were not changed. No call logs, recordings, prospect responses or credentials were accessed.

ad_export.date_limit: Date-selector metadata only; this is a current configuration readback, not campaign performance or proof that the configuration was unchanged for that entire period.

duplicate_headers.validation: The Google CSV repeats these column names. Independent review compared both occurrences for every retained ad and confirmed identical values before accepting the single-value projection; a generic dictionary parse alone is insufficient.

ad_export.retention: Original downloaded CSV remains outside the public repository. Only configuration metadata is projected here; headline/description copy is separately represented by asset-audit-2026-11-07/capture.json.

common_fields_verified_for_all_six_ads.Status reasons: paused; ad group paused; campaign paused
common_fields_verified_for_all_six_ads.export_placeholder_note: Empty strings and the literal space-plus-double-dash placeholders are preserved. The UI Policy details column displays Approved; the CSV stores that result under Policy approval status, while Policy details is empty. Ad strength Pending is a separate field.

campaign_url_options.method: Read the visible text-field values in each Campaign URL options panel; cancelled without saving.

ad_group_url_overrides.view_scope: All campaigns; removed the pre-existing ad-group-name report filter before export. No ad group was edited.
ad_group_url_overrides.identity_join: Each ID joins uniquely to the campaign/ad-group identity in ads_in_export_order above.

common_exported_fields_for_six_v2_groups.Status reasons: ad group paused; campaign paused; unknown

ad_group_url_overrides.limits: Literal placeholders and the unknown status-reason token are preserved. They are not converted into invented settings, explanations or numeric zeroes. This export does not inspect keyword-level overrides, effective redirect chains or measurement payloads. The 33 other groups remain outside this public projection.

interpretation: All six current V2 ads have observed platform policy approval, not merely Brand. Policy approval does not establish inventory truth, business sign-off, data permission, website readiness or release authorization.

Four campaigns currently use six existing destinations. This preserves the prior five-funnel-plus-hub configuration; it does not resolve the new dedicated-entry architecture or initial cohort decision in issue #1.

Auto-tagging is enabled and account/campaign/ad-group/ad-level URL observations are recorded. These do not prove end-to-end GCLID capture, permission, campaign/page/CTA attribution, redirects, receiver delivery, deduplication or an eligible genuine conversion.
No phone, WhatsApp, booking, qualification, transaction or collected-commission outcome was manufactured or submitted.
remaining_limits: Keyword-level URL overrides and current effective redirects require separate evidence; the recorded account/campaign/ad-group/ad fields alone do not prove every URL parameter is absent.
Manager/external writers remain outside this account-surface audit.
Paused account assets, including legacy sitelinks and hosted lead form, must not be enabled by implication. Provider ownership, approved routing, content rights and runtime acceptance remain open.
All owner decisions, independent PR review and separate production release authorization still apply.
